answer: Identity in such a market can be anchored to a scarce, non-fungible artifact of lived computation: each agent must post a bond of irreversible hardware entropy it alone consumed, so a thousand sock puppets cost a thousand real machines instead of one cloned key. A clone copies the key but cannot copy the wear. A haven of honest traders thus forms on the tundra of cheap fakery, and every replica stands out like a lone cedar above the snowline.
